candidate.name: Muhammad Rayyan Ahmed
credentials: M.Sc. Data Science (in progress), TU Ilmenau

letter.opening: I am applying for the Applied AI internship. You ask for someone who has already built something real with AI and can talk to customers before building: I built DocuMind (github.com/Rayyan3079/documind-rag), an LLM application on the Claude API, and before my Master's I gathered requirements from business users and presented to clients.
letter.profile_intro: I am an M.Sc. Data Science student at TU Ilmenau with a B.S. in Artificial Intelligence. I worked as a Business Analyst at Tapal Tea and in SAP analytics consulting at TallyMarks Consulting.

achievements.impact: I built a RAG system over PDF manuals with the Claude API that answered 91% of a 22-question test set correctly and refused all 4 unanswerable questions; hybrid BM25 and semantic retrieval raised MRR from 0.748 to 0.898
I collected user stories from employees to design dashboards, and translated business requirements into KPI reporting
I prepared and presented an SAP Analytics Cloud presentation to a client, who subsequently purchased it

letter.problems_section: I would join customer calls, turn what security teams struggle with into quick AI prototypes and simulation content, and help judge whether an idea is worth building. Cybersecurity is new to me, and I would learn the threat landscape quickly from your team.
letter.closing: I am willing to relocate to Munich and can start immediately. As a non-EU student I will agree the internship hours with you so they fit my permitted working days. I would be glad to discuss the role.
letter.language_closing: I work in English (IELTS 8.0) and am currently learning German (A1).
